title: Retrieve Package Information
text: pkginfo allow users retrieve information R package CRAN, GitHub, Travis CI, Appveyor, Codecov & Stack Overflow. developed keeping specific end user mind, package developers might find useful can monitor R packages using shiny app. pkginfo uses cranlogs,crandb cchecksapi hood.

title: Retrieve package information — CranPackage
text: create CranPackage objects, need use CranPackage$new("package_name"). myPackage$get_downloads() return downloads package RStudio CRAN mirror last day, last week, last month total downloads. myPackage$get_cran_check_results() return CRAN check results package. myPackage$get_title() return title package. myPackage$get_description() return description package. myPackage$get_version() return version package. myPackage$get_r_dep() return R dependency package. myPackage$get_imports() return R packages imported package. myPackage$get_suggests() return R packages suggested package. myPackage$get_publish_date() return date package published CRAN. myPackage$get_license() return license package released. myPackage$get_authors() return names authors package. myPackage$get_maintainer() return name maintainer package. myPackage$get_urls() return URLs associated package.
